label: D1 after recent reward omission (unrewarded last or second-to-last trial)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), on about 36% of D1 steps. Within D1 it is driven by recent missing rewards: rate is about 54% when the reward just shown is 0 vs about 26% when it is 1. Adding an omission two trials back raises dev F1 from 0.53 to 0.59 (mass recall 0.76). Precision is 0.73 when both of the last two trials were unrewarded, and the top-activating windows are runs of unrewarded trials, often with repeated a2 choices and rare transitions, so magnitude appears to grow with the length of the losing streak. It is silent when the value head is high (value > 8.1) and when the policy logit at D1 is extreme, and it peaks at mid value (7.1-7.5). Value-range and choice-confidence predicates do not beat bare D1 (F1 about 0.52). Many activations follow rewarded trials and many omission trials stay silent, so this is a D1 reward-history / low-confidence feature that only partly matches a boolean description. The predicate uses only observed reward history.
